effects.prompt: Discard a card with cost 0 to search for a combo card?

_comment:
Ninja Hero - Young (HistoryPack1). 'The first time an attack action card you control hits each turn, you may discard a card with cost 0. If you do, search your deck for a card with combo, banish it face up, then shuffle your deck. You may play it this turn.'

TRIGGER: TRIGGERED ON_HIT with once_per_turn='katsu_combo' (ability-level key, checked after all other gates per interpreter.py:69-85). Conditions: ATTACK_TYPE_IN ['Action'] (condition_types.py:273-294 reads types+subtypes, so 'Action' matches attack action cards) and ATTACK_CONTROLLED_BY_YOU (condition_types.py:389-396) ensure only your attack action cards count.

MAY WRAPPER: The 'you may discard... If you do' is a single MAY block whose cost is DISCARD_CARD with a filter for cost 0 (CARD_COST_LTE 0 via _hand_card_filter's generic condition-spec escape hatch at effect_types.py:498). Declining the prompt runs nothing, so 'if you do' needs no separate plumbing.

SEARCH_DECK: keyword 'combo' finds a card with the combo keyword; destination 'banished' routes it to the banished zone face-up (effect_types.py:1728, banish destination has no face_up param; banished-zone visibility is cosmetic). The handler shuffles the deck after.

GRANT_PLAY_FROM_BANISHED: uses the ref 'searched' that SEARCH_DECK stores the found card under (effect_types.py:4232 reads ref/power_mod). This appends to player.playable_from_banished, which play.py consults and clears at start of next turn â€” matching 'this turn'.

KNOWN GAP: 'banish it face up' â€” SEARCH_DECK's banish destination has no face_up param; the card goes to banished zone but face-up state is not explicitly set. Cosmetic only.

PRINTED KEYWORDS: none listed, so no keyword abilities to suppress.
